{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Rule of Fifty"''' was legislation created by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in its early years that restricted the amount of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] to fifty. It was developed after the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] had become too large with each sizable planet receiving some form of representation. Fearing that large sectors could form break-away factions, an agreement was reached with all the [[Politics/Legends|politicking]] parties that allowed certain worlds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] to retain their a seat along with increased representation in politically powerful [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. By the days of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], the so-called "Rule of Fifty" had become largely ignored, resulting in over-sized and unmanageable sectors. The failing bureaucracy helped to fuel the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] at the dawn of the [[Indecta Era]]. The law was removed during the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] led large changes to the Republic's structure.
